summary: Iteration 72: Tested mark-goods-ready endpoint extension for non-provisional orders. All backend features working correctly. The endpoint now accepts non-provisional orders with status in (confirmed, processing, goods_ready) and correctly: (1) stamps rolls + vendor_invoice on items, (2) sets status='goods_ready', goods_ready_at, goods_ready_by, (3) does NOT recompute totals or flip payment_status, (4) does NOT send balance-due email, (5) fires internal GOODS_READY event.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/orders/{id}/mark-goods-ready correctly branches on is_provisional flag
Non-provisional gating: status in (confirmed, processing, goods_ready) - allows re-marking for edit flow
Provisional gating: payment_status in (advance_paid, balance_pending) - unchanged from before
Non-provisional flow: only stamps rolls/invoice, sets status=goods_ready, goods_ready_at, goods_ready_by
Non-provisional flow: does NOT recompute actual_total, balance_amount, or flip payment_status
Non-provisional flow: does NOT send balance-due email (customer already paid in full)
Internal GOODS_READY event fires for BOTH provisional and non-provisional orders
Vendor authorization: 403 if vendor tries to mark items from other sellers
Invoice requirement: vendor must provide invoice, admin can skip

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 endpoint tests passed, 6/12 state-dependent tests passed with 6 skipped due to no orders in required state)
